-- REQ: LANG-1611 LANG-1612 LANG-1613 LANG-1614 note description: "Greets people." class GREETER create make feature make (a_name: STRING) require name_not_void: a_name /= Void do name := a_name end greet (times: INTEGER): STRING local i: INTEGER do from i := 1 until i > times loop Result := "Hello, " + name + "!%N" i := i + 1 end ensure result_exists: Result /= Void end name: STRING end
